prompt.project_info: A lively warm Tokyo street portrait with low sun, a dark textured outfit, and softly cinematic city motion.
prompt.main_subject: An adult Japanese woman with long wavy light-brown hair, peach-pink eye makeup, curled lashes, rosy blush, rose-pink matte lips, and dangling earrings. She wears a black ribbed short-sleeve top with a high neckline and black straight-leg jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter vertical outdoor city portrait from mid-thigh upward. She turns gently toward camera with a relaxed expression; Tokyo buildings and an unbranded pedestrian crowd blur in the background. Keep any signage indistinct and unreadable.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft bright late-afternoon sunlight at approximately 4600K from behind creates a light hair rim and mild lens flare. Preserve natural skin, wind-tossed hair, realistic denim texture, and fine film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2, vertical 3:4 crop, shallow depth of field, crisp face focus, soft city bokeh, airy muted grade, gentle vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end outdoor fashion portrait of an adult Japanese woman with long wavy light-brown hair and soft peach-pink makeup, dangling earrings, a black ribbed short-sleeve high-neck top, and black straight-leg jeans. Three-quarter vertical framing on a Tokyo city street, relaxed engaging gaze, natural daylight, late-afternoon sun behind her creating a gentle hair rim and mild lens flare, blurred unbranded pedestrians and buildings, realistic skin and denim detail, shallow depth of field, airy film grain, warm playful urban atmosphere, no readable signs or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed midriff, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, distorted anatomy
